This coffee shop has it all: great atmosphere, good coffee, and good service. The prices are mid-range and reasonable, making it suitable for both coffee lovers and those looking for a place to work or relax in the Charoen Charoen market area. ☕️💛

user_reviews.Description:
If you are looking for a peaceful escape and a memorable experience, I highly recommend this Pimnaree Slow Bar Cafe. It was like entering a tranquil oasis. The smell of rice stalks, the birds chirping and the soft music playing in the backgrounds made me feel my home.
The owner's generosity was exceptional! He played a guitar and sang songs for us.
He allowed us to stay and watch the sunset, which was a beautiful and unforgettable experience. It's the little touches like this that make a stay truly special. We felt very welcome and would definitely return. This cafe becomes our favourite place in Chiang Mai.

Highly recommended.

user_reviews.text_translated: This is a very cute and relaxing cafe by the rice fields. Parking is available, but you might need to back up. user_reviews.Description:
A true hidden gem. This small café is full of character, with old Thai movie posters covering the walls, an eclectic collection of cinema memorabilia and pop culture figurines, and countless little details to discover wherever you look. The atmosphere is incredibly relaxing, with a homemade pond, the sound of running water, a hammock, and plenty of plants creating a peaceful oasis.

The food was delicious, the Thai tea excellent, the prices very reasonable, and the owner genuinely friendly. I stumbled upon this place almost by accident, but I'll definitely be coming back on purpose.

title: Aunty Lek Coffeehouse
address: 87 Bumrung Buri Rd, เทศบาลนครเชียงใหม่ Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200

complete_address.borough: เทศบาลนครเชียงใหม่

user_reviews.Description:
A local told me about Aunty Lek's Coffeehouse. That was a while ago now, and I haven't found a reason to start my mornings anywhere else.

It sits on the strip between the inner and outer moat roads, directly across from Chiang Mai Gate Market. Motorbikes, vendors, monks on alms rounds, tourists trying to figure out which way is north. You can sit with a coffee and watch the whole morning go by.

The coffee is good. Aunty Lek and her daughter Yuy run the place, along with a rotating cast of regulars who will make room for you at the table whether you asked for company or not.

And on days when it isn't raining, the cats come too. Lek and Yuy bring them down for the customers, which tells you most of what you need to know about the place.

Come for the coffee and the company. I'll see you there.

user_reviews.Description:
🍃🍏🐎🍃

That was nice surprise to reach out this place. From beginning to end we were amazed by service level, kindness and open minded staff. We were greeted by delicious coffee shots and delightful view while waiting for manager to get free to service us. In Thailand life is relaxed and chilled, so if you have to wait, just use this time properly 😉

During coffee break manager introduced us to possibilities of routes and prices. I LOVED answer yes to any question. (if you wonder, you can ride up to the temple and down, it takes 2h)

🍃🍏🐎🍃

So for us it was perfect to take ride for 1h, when firstly you get instructed, then try riding in circle, get comfortable on horse, while check your level and give advices.
Then you go out with 3 (!!!) people escorting us. 2 persons for 2 horses, and 1 person as photographer (really nice girl, speaks really good english and even some russian). I think if you visit this place regularly / they know you, you can go on your own.

The most treasured thing about the trip is +250 photos and videos in a gallery. They put horses together, make background, scenes. Pictures look like we were alone there. Just us, on horses, in the forest. Wow, just wow.

🍃🍏🐎🍃

Also want to point that horses look happy and well maintained. I was amazed how polite they are to hide in the grass to make pee pee. Or try not to eat too much grass to pause ride.
Also after trip you can feed them for 50 baht.

Absolutely will come back to get to the top where the temple settled.

Thank Pong Horse Team for this adventure 😘😘

title: ON THE WAY CAFE @ Jang Sri Poom
address: Manee Nopparat Rd, Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200

user_reviews.Description:
Stepping into On the Way Cafe @ Jan Sri Poom was an absolute delight. It quickly became my favorite Chiang Mai stop. I was immediately struck by the truly calming atmosphere. The interior design thoughtfully uses soft, warm lighting, natural wood tones, and lush greenery, creating a peaceful escape from the city bustle. It’s the perfect environment whether you need to focus on work, enjoy a quiet read, or simply unwind. I happily spent several hours here and felt completely relaxed and welcome.
Beyond the aesthetics, the service here is genuinely top-tier. Every member of the team is exceptionally friendly, attentive, and clearly passionate about their craft. They were patient in explaining different brewing methods and offered excellent recommendations tailored precisely to my preferences. My order was served quickly, always with a genuine smile, which truly elevated the entire visit.
The menu boasts an impressive variety of cold and hot drinks, catering to every possible craving imaginable. I first tried their signature iced latte, which was perfectly balanced and refreshing, and later enjoyed a rich, expertly crafted hot chocolate. They also frequently have unique seasonal specials and a fantastic selection of teas. This cafe is a must-visit gem—a rare combination of superb quality, peaceful ambiance, and five-star hospitality. Recommended!

user_reviews.Description:
CAFE DEEJUNG is a cozy, friendly, small, family ran coffee shop that serves coffee, tea, smoothies, fruit sodas and variety of home-made snacks✨️

The cafe is situated right by the roadside in Baan Patana Sai Kheow, which is between Maejo university and Baan Pa Muad/Baan Palan in Sansai Luang district, Chiangmai Province.
Their service is excellent, the atmosphere is very inviting, the drinks are great and the prices extremely friendly. Everyone who visits CAFE DEEJUNG is always met with a warm smile and a geniune atmosphere of sincerity.

The owners recently added more ground space due to growing popularity and the new sliding glass doors function as a glass wall with sun blinds. This helps to bring in light to the room, makes the room appear larger, while simultaneously giving a view of the street.

Even when CAFE DEEJUNG is crowded with people placing orders, enjoying their drinks or collecting their orders to go, there is sitting space available outside. Behind the coffee shop there is a small table with chairs under the cool shade of a massive tree and a ready hammock waiting for anyone needing to relax or take a short power-nap in the hot afternoon.

If you happen to be in the area, feel free to drop-in.

CAFE DEEJUNG comes highly recommended...✨️✨️✨️✨️✨️

user_reviews.Description:
I discovered this café by chance a year ago, but it quickly became my go-to spot almost every day. The owner is truly passionate about coffee and puts great care into every cup served—and the staff are just as dedicated!

My favorite menu item is the iced Americano. The house blend is already well-balanced and satisfying, but if you’re looking for something with a special touch, the floral blend brings a unique and refreshing twist that makes it even more memorable.

Whether you're sitting in to relax or grabbing a cup to go, you’ll always be greeted warmly with friendly service that makes every visit feel welcoming.

user_reviews.Description:
The atmosphere and space of the café are very lovely, but the customer service from the young female staff member was incredibly immature, resulting in a highly unreasonable and frustrating experience.
When ordering, I repeatedly stated and confirmed "No sugar," yet she kept an expressionless face and offered absolutely no response. At the end, she misspoke as "Low sugar" (or pronounced it in a highly confusing way). When I double-checked by asking, "No sugar, right?", instead of apologizing, she took an arrogant attitude as if to say, "That’s what I said from the beginning?!" That was the first instance where I had a truly bad buying experience.
What was even more unbelievable was when my young child used the restroom. She blankly thrust her phone with a translation app screen in front of me, which read, "Your child played with water in the restroom and made a mess." When I said, "I'm sorry," she simply stared blankly, remained completely silent, and walked away.
Ignoring a customer who is sincerely apologizing and coldly venting her emotions like a robot is completely lacking in basic manners and professionalism for anyone in the service industry.
The wonderful space and menu of this café are entirely ruined by the immature pride and poor communication skills of this single staff member. Ultimately, after being subjected to this kind of cafe experience, I feel like I never want to visit this place again.

user_reviews.Description:
All out 5 star, even before tasting the drinks I would have given this guy a 5 star for its service and atmosphere!
Amazed and surprise at how this guy brew and makes the drinks in detail just like in a expensive or fine dining cafe/coffee house. The cafe is just a small cafe along the way in a alley, I was just searching for a coffee place to takeaway a coffee back to our villa to drink before heading out. I expected to be either just make from the machine or just a normal fast brewing looking at the shop outlook and small space which looks like those express coffee.
However I was totally wrong! This guy spends at least a good 20 minutes just to make 4 drinks of cocoa, latte, matcha and americano. You can choose from mild, medium or dark coffee roast beans.
This barista literally brew the coffee from stirring the matcha using traditional methods, grinding the cocoa using chocolate pieces till making the latte cream everything into perfection! It's so satisfying to even see him make the drinks, after a good 20mins he put the cups into the plastic and knowing I was driving, he told me it's not safe and took the cups out to seal it individually with a paper below the cover and double seal it with a rubber band to prevent any single spillage which I'm very appreciative of. This small actions truly makes you want to go back to this place for its service which would definitely make your day.
And truly enough the drinks are of very good taste! The ingredients he uses is of good quality and definitely above average standard. I witness the process and ingredients he uses.
This small cosy cafe is also clean, only downside is that is along a narrow road/alley which you might need to park slightly further away and walk back down.

user_reviews.text_translated: I bought a brand new Zentis espresso machine from Alisons. To summarize, it broke down on the first day; the steam boiler didn't work. I had to close my shop to send it back and wait for a replacement. I emphasized to Alisons that I wanted a new machine, not a repaired one. They insisted on a new one. After a few months, it broke down again. I contacted Alisons about the warranty, and they said there would be labor and travel costs, totaling at least 4,000 baht. I found a local technician, and after repairs, they said the internal tubing was brittle and clogged, even though it was brand new and I barely used it—no more than 10 cups a day. After that, it worked for another two months before breaking down again, this time leaking water. I had to fix it myself. Initially, I thought the repairs were over, but now it feels like a never-ending cycle of repairs. In short, anyone considering buying equipment or espresso machines from Alisons should think carefully.

- A cozy, homey-style cafe located under a renovated wooden house, giving it a modern and chic look. The bar area is adorably decorated in brown tones with green accents from the plants and the lawn. You can bring your own outdoor chairs to sit on. There are various seating areas to suit your preference, creating a spacious, airy, and comfortable atmosphere. Plenty of photo opportunities.
- A wide variety of drinks and desserts are available at reasonable prices. 5/5
- Cleanliness of the shop: 5/5
- Parking is limited. There's space for 3-5 motorcycles and 1-2 cars. 😄 We recommend finding parking on the street in front of the house.
- Excellent service. The owner is kind, attentive to every customer, and very friendly. 😆👍
They're great at recommending things and chatting. If you're coming alone and worried about being lonely, you definitely won't be bored here! 😆😄

title: Maison de la fleur
address: 90 Maison de la fleur Banpong Tambon Ban Pong, Hang Dong District, Chiang Mai 50230

user_reviews.Description:
A lovely café, perfect for a slow, relaxing visit and capturing beautiful photos.

From homemade brunch to truly delicious homemade cakes, every dish is freshly prepared with care, soft, flavorful, and not too sweet, just perfectly balanced. Enjoy them with a cup of coffee or tea while soaking in the cozy garden atmosphere.

DON’T MISS the macarons and caramel butter short bread also Basque burnt cheesecake beautifully made, delicate, and truly some of the best.

Take a gentle stroll and capture moments in the misty garden at Flora Creek Krisda Doi, where soft morning steam drifts through the greenery, creating a dreamy, peaceful setting ideal for slow walks and photography.

Don’t miss the old wooden house, carefully preserved as part of the garden’s charm. A quiet reminder of the past, lovingly cared for and embraced by nature, it’s a beautiful spot for photos that feel warm, timeless, and full of stories 🤍📸

Nice place especially with the cool weather.

Unfortunately not a good experience for us at all. Food came very late and only one out of two dishes served. My drink also took time to arrive.

Only when we asked , the service staff said out of rice and to wait another 30 mins. We went to pay so we could find food elsewhere and had to wait again and then said rice is ready but I was already so hungry , we decided to cancel the 2nd dish and left to find food at 7eleven 😅

I understand its a small business but communication is important , so please inform your customers if food is delayed instead of keeping customers waiting for so long. I hope you can improve as its a nice cafe place.

We unfortunately won't be coming back here.

title: 91m5 Cafe
address: XX4M+FC6 91m5 Cafe Mae Faek Mai, San Sai District, Chiang Mai 50290

user_reviews.Description:
I first struggled to read the name “91m5 Cafe”, but then the owner explained—it comes from their house address: 91, Moo 5. Simple and creative!

The café is really cute, set right in front of the owner’s home, just before the PTT Nong Han gas station. Prices are very reasonable: an iced espresso is 45 baht, and an iced mint cocoa is 50 baht. Both taste great!

If you’re driving from Chiang Mai city back to Phrao, this is the perfect little stop. Honestly, it’s cheaper than Café Amazon, with better flavor—and they even have a stamp card where you can collect points for a free drink.

👉 Cozy, affordable, and worth a visit on your way through.

Dr. Niwech

user_reviews.Description:
This beautiful coffee shop is located on San Sai road with ample parking in front. It is family run as most places in Thailand.
It is light and airy with inside or outside seating and many spots convenient for working on a laptop. Every item is made of quality and it is very welcoming inside. It is impeccably clean.
We had a latte, it came out strong but not bitter, made just right with some of the best coffee beans available. Also enjoyed a mocha, which was equally great.
Every order comes with a small glass of ice water.
We did not have any food items as we arrived after 3 pm.
The service was very friendly and attentive but not intrusive, English was spoken well. Prices are average.

We really enjoyed our time and will be back !!(although it is a little ways from old town it was a wonderful way to learn more about more residential area)

When I ordered drinks, I saw 2-3 employees.
There were no other customers at the time, and the employees weren't busy.

The person taking my order was suffering from a severe cold. While taking the order, they took off their mask and wiped their nose with their hand.
I tried to mentally prepare myself, thinking another employee would probably make the drinks later.

After taking the order, the same employee went to get the cups, touching the inside of the rims a bit, and then made the drinks. They were visibly ill with the cold the entire time.

I ordered two drinks and paid almost 100 baht. I don't know what they tasted like because I threw them in the trash as soon as I left the shop!

I urge the owner to consider improving the cleanliness and hygiene of their service to customers.

user_reviews.Description:
รีวิว คาเฟ่ลับๆ สไตล์โฮมมี่สุดคิ้วท์ บรรยากาศอบอุ่นเหมือนบ้านเพื่อน ✨

ใครกำลังมองหาร้านกาแฟเล็กๆ บรรยากาศอบอุ่น สบายตา และเป็นกันเอง ต้องไม่พลาดร้านนี้เลยคะ!

"922 CAFE" ร้านกาแฟไซส์มินิสีขาวคลีน ที่ผสมผสานความโฮมมี่เข้ากับกลิ่นอายความสดใสแบบบีชคาเฟ่ได้อย่างลงตัวมาก

🏡 บรรยากาศหน้าร้านและภายใน
โซน Outdoor: หน้าร้านตกแต่งได้น่ารักสดใสมาก มีการใช้เซิร์ฟบอร์ด ห่วงยางสีชมพู-ฟ้า และป้ายไม้แฮนด์เมด ให้ฟีลเหมือนอยู่ริมทะเล นั่งจิบกาแฟใต้ร่มคันใหญ่บนลานกรวดชิลๆ ถ่ายรูปเช็คอินมุมไหนก็ปัง

โซน Indoor: พอเดินเข้ามาด้านในจะเจอกับความอบอุ่นสไตล์โฮมมี่ ร้านคุมโทนสีขาว สะอาดตา ตกแต่งด้วยต้นไม้สีเขียวตามมุมต่างๆ เพิ่มความสดใสด้วยเฟอร์นิเจอร์และของตกแต่งสีส้ม-น้ำเงิน แฝงความเท่ด้วยโปสเตอร์ลายแจ๊ส มีมุมที่นั่งริมหน้าต่างติดม่านโปร่งแสงที่ให้แสงธรรมชาติละมุนๆ ถ่ายรูปสวยมากค่ะ

เจ้าของดูแลเอง สะอาด ใส่ใจ อัธยาศัยดี

If you're looking for a small, cozy, and friendly coffee shop, you can't miss this one!

"922 CAFE" is a mini-sized coffee shop with a clean white interior that perfectly blends a homey feel with a bright, beach cafe vibe.

🏡 Exterior and Interior Atmosphere
Outdoor Zone: The front of the shop is decorated adorably and brightly, featuring surfboards, pink and blue inflatable rings, and handmade wooden signs, giving it a beachy feel. Enjoy your coffee under a large umbrella on a gravel patio – every corner is perfect for photos!

Indoor Zone: Upon entering, you'll find a warm, homey atmosphere. The shop has a clean, white color scheme, decorated with green plants in various corners. Orange and blue furniture and decorations add a touch of brightness, while jazz-themed posters add a cool edge. There are window seats with sheer curtains that let in soft natural light – perfect for photos!

Spacious parking available.
Prices are affordable.
Owner-run, clean, attentive, and friendly.
Delivery service available (call to inquire).

user_reviews.text_translated:
This is a small cafe with an amazing selection of ceremonial-grade matcha. I was shocked by the sheer number! The owner is incredibly lovely. She'll brew you an unsweetened sample first so you can decide how much syrup to add for a balanced flavor. You can also order a half-cup to try other flavors.

The owner is very meticulous and attentive. She wears a mask and uses special straw tongs – super hygienic! Before I left, she even gave me a zip-lock bag and moisture-absorbing sachet to help me store the matcha properly at home. If you want to try some of the cafe's most famous and premium matcha brands, this is the place to go. The menu clearly lists all the brands they use.🥹💕

Atmosphere: The restaurant is incredibly beautiful and shady, like a dream garden restaurant. From the front of the shop to the entrance with its passion fruit arch (the trees were full of green fruit when I went), there's a lotus pond, flowers all around, and a vegetable garden with lots of lemons and chili peppers. It's so relaxing and shady to sit and eat.
Food and Drinks: The single dishes are served in huge portions, enough to fill you up completely. The taste is delicious, with a homemade feel like mom's cooking. I also love the gimmick of serving a side salad with every dish. They also have drinks and coffee. I highly recommend it; you won't be disappointed! 🥰

user_reviews.Description: Very good coffee and cakes.  Not expensive at all.  Hot Americano coffee only 30 baht.  Cold iced drinks from 35 baht.  Good atmosphere and nice decorations.   Right next to Kerry Express and opposite Doi Saket hospital on Highway 118.  20km east of Chiang Mai city in a beautiful area which also has 3 lakes to visit and The Beach made out of an old stone quarry.  Doi Saket has many things to see while stopping here.  Beautiful old temple on the hill too.  Stop here for your coffee.  Recommended.

user_reviews.Description:
Minimal coffee - flagship store คาเฟ่ดีไซน์มินิมอลสุดชิค กาแฟสเปเชียลตี้รสชาติเยี่ยม ราคามิตรภาพ อิ่มอร่อยสดชื่นทั้งที่ร้านและเดลิเวอรี

สำหรับคอกาแฟและสายคาเฟ่ฮอปปิ้งที่กำลังมองหาร้านกาแฟคุณภาพดีในเชียงใหม่ ขอแนะนำให้มาปักหมุดที่ Minimal coffee - flagship store เลยครับ ตัวร้านตั้งอยู่ในทำเลที่เดินทางสะดวก ค้นหาง่าย โดดเด่นด้วยการตกแต่งสไตล์มินิมอลคุมโทนสีขาวคลีนๆ ผสมผสานความโมเดิร์นได้อย่างลงตัว บรรยากาศภายในร้านสะอาดสะอ้าน โปร่งโล่งสบายตา มีแสงธรรมชาติส่องถึง และจัดสรรพื้นที่นั่งได้อย่างเป็นระเบียบเรียบร้อย เหมาะสำหรับการมานั่งพักผ่อน จิบกาแฟชิลๆ ถ่ายรูปสวยๆ หรือจะแวะมาสั่งเครื่องดื่มแก้วโปรดไปเติมพลังระหว่างวันก็ตอบโจทย์ได้อย่างยอดเยี่ยมครับ

ไฮไลท์เด่นที่ทำให้ร้านนี้ครองใจสายกินได้อย่างเหนียวแน่น คือคุณภาพของเมล็ดกาแฟที่คัดสรรมาเป็นอย่างดีและมีเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว เมนูเครื่องดื่มมีให้เลือกหลากหลาย ตั้งแต่เอสเพรสโซ่รสชาติเข้มข้นกลมกล่อม ลาเต้เนื้อเนียนนุ่ม ไปจนถึงเมนูฟิวชันชวนรีเฟรชรสชาติแปลกใหม่ที่มิกซ์กันได้อย่างลงตัว ไม่ว่าจะเป็นสายกาแฟนมหรือกาแฟดำก็ฟินได้ใจ ยิ่งสั่งทานคู่กับเบเกอรี่อบสดใหม่หอมกรุ่นของทางร้าน บอกเลยว่าเข้ากันได้อย่างสมบูรณ์แบบมาก ปริมาณและคุณภาพอาหารคุ้มค่าคุ้มราคา เป็นมิตรกับกระเป๋าตังค์มากๆ ครับ

ในส่วนของการบริการ บาริสต้าและพนักงานทุกคนน่ารักมาก ยิ้มแย้มแจ่มใส พูดจาสุภาพเรียบร้อย และมีความเป็นมืออาชีพ คอยแนะนำเมนูเครื่องดื่มให้ตามความชอบของลูกค้าได้อย่างเป็นกันเอง ระบบการจัดการออเดอร์ทำได้รวดเร็วว่องไวทันใจ สำหรับสายสั่งเดลิเวอรีผ่าน Grab ทางร้านก็แพ็คเกจจิ้งมาได้อย่างดีเยี่ยม แยกน้ำแข็ง มัดถุง และปิดฝาแก้วมาอย่างมิดชิดแน่นหนา ไม่มีหกเลอะเทอะ เครื่องดื่มส่งถึงมือในสภาพที่ยังเย็นฉ่ำรสชาติไม่เสีย มาตรฐานความสะอาดภายในร้านดูแลได้อย่างเนี๊ยบไร้ที่ติ ใครที่อยากลิ้มลองกาแฟรสชาติดีในบรรยากาศสุดชิค แนะนำร้านนี้เลยครับ ประทับใจแน่นอน

ในส่วนของการบริการ บาริสต้าและพนักงานทุกคนน่ารักมาก ยิ้มแย้มแจ่มใส พูดจาสุภาพเรียบร้อย และมีความเป็นมืออาชีพ คอยแนะนำเมนูเครื่องดื่มให้ตามความชอบของลูกค้าได้อย่างเป็นกันเอง ระบบการจัดการออเดอร์ทำได้รวดเร็วว่องไวทันใจ สำหรับสายสั่งเดลิเวอรีผ่าน Grab ทางร้านก็แพ็คเกจจิ้งมาได้อย่างดีเยี่ยม แยกน้ำแข็ง มัดถุง และปิดฝาแก้วมาอย่างมิดชิดแน่นหนา ไม่มีหกเลอะเทอะ เครื่องดื่มส่งถึงมือในสภาพที่ยังเย็นฉ่ำรสชาติไม่เสีย มาตรฐานความสะอาดภายในร้านดูแลได้อย่างเนี๊ยบไร้ที่ติ ใครที่อยากลิ้มลองกาแฟรสชาติดีในบรรยากาศสุดชิค แนะนำร้านนี้เลยครับ ประทับใจแน่นอน
user_reviews.text_translated:
Minimal Coffee - Flagship Store: A chic minimalist cafe offering excellent specialty coffee at friendly prices, perfect for both dine-in and delivery.

For coffee lovers and cafe hoppers looking for a high-quality coffee shop in Chiang Mai, we highly recommend Minimal Coffee - Flagship Store. Conveniently located and easy to find, the store boasts a clean, minimalist design with a white color scheme, seamlessly blending modern elements. The interior is clean, bright, and airy, with plenty of natural light and well-organized seating areas. It's ideal for relaxing, enjoying a coffee, taking beautiful photos, or simply stopping by for your favorite drink to recharge during the day.

A key highlight that has made this cafe a favorite among foodies is the high-quality, uniquely flavored coffee beans. The drink menu offers a wide variety of options, from rich and smooth espressos and creamy lattes to refreshing and innovative fusion drinks. Whether you prefer milk-based or black coffee, you'll find something to enjoy. Pairing your drink with the cafe's freshly baked pastries creates a perfectly harmonious combination. The portions and quality of the food and drinks are excellent value for money. It's very budget-friendly!

As for the service, all the baristas and staff are lovely, cheerful, polite, and professional. They are happy to recommend drinks based on customer preferences in a friendly manner. The order management system is fast and efficient. For those ordering delivery via Grab, the packaging is excellent. Ice is separated, the bag is sealed, and the cup is tightly closed, preventing spills. The drinks arrive still cold and the taste is perfect. The cleanliness of the shop is impeccable. If you want to try great coffee in a chic atmosphere, I highly recommend this shop. You'll be impressed!

user_reviews.Description: I'm writing this review solely for the owners of this cafe and hotel, as I understand that Chiang Mai's tourism and hospitality industries have been struggling for the past years due to various reasons, covid, flood, negative news, etc. This cafe is affiliated with the hotel, and I happened to pass by and stopped in for coffee and breakfast. The cafe and hotel are beautiful, with a lovely atmosphere. The hot latte was good, and the set breakfast was regular and okay. However, when I picked up the strawberry jam to spread on my bread, I noticed it was opened and a corner had been eaten. I assumed it was recycled, presumably the last customer hadn't eaten it, but actually he/she did. I handed it to the staff, who immediately replaced it from the kitchen without even a word of apology. In my opinion, this is a serious management issue. I hope the owners will take note and make improvements. After all, such a beautiful cafe and hotel, I wish it'll have good business.

user_reviews.Description:
This place is very pleasant. A clean airy interior and pleasant serving staff.
It is next door to a bakery that sells food at 3 times the price. This place is better value.
I had a bacon and egg sandwich with extra avocado along with a Lime Smoothie.
The smoothie was nice and tart.
The sandwich itself consisted of thick bread. I do find thai bread marginally sweet. This was fresh and toasted on one side. A solid amount of nicely scrambled eggs, the bacon was a generous serve and also nicely fried. Tomato and sliced avocado added a nice fresh contrast.
Overall this was an enjoyable breakfast, the cafe needs a bit more recognition.
There is an extensive menu with plenty of healthy options.
Recommended and I would eat here again if there were not several thousand other options.

user_reviews.Description:
If you find yourself in Chiang Mai and are looking for a place where you can not only have a great meal but also have a nice time, Tsuneki Ramen is the place to go. The name of the place may not be too well known due to Google Maps misunderstandings, but trust me, it's worth it.

Stepping inside, you will immediately feel the welcoming atmosphere, thanks to the wonderful staff and cozy ambiance. The interior is complemented by comfortable furniture and a huge collection of graphic novels, which will especially appeal to fans of reading and Japanese culture. Despite the fact that the cafe is located next to the road, it is surprisingly quiet inside, allowing you to completely relax and enjoy a delicious meal.

Speaking of food, Tsuneki Ramen's menu will delight you with a variety of flavors. I stopped in here for a coffee but couldn't resist their culinary offerings. Everything I tried was simply delicious and the prices were quite nice.

This place deserves to be much more popular. I wish Tsuneki Ramen a huge success and I am sure that everyone who visits here will be satisfied with their visit. Don't miss this gem of Chiang Mai

user_reviews.Description:
Baan Yam Chaidan Coffee is a lovely little café surrounded by greenery and peaceful vibes. The atmosphere is calm and relaxing, with outdoor seating right next to a small stream where you can enjoy your drink while listening to the sound of flowing water. If you prefer cooler air, there is also a cozy air-conditioned room inside that offers a comfortable place to sit and unwind.

The prices here are surprisingly reasonable. Freshly brewed coffee starts from just 30 baht, and most drinks on the menu are around 45 baht and up. Despite the affordable prices, the quality of the coffee is excellent. The barista is friendly, polite, and always provides great service with a smile, making every visit pleasant.

This café is also very convenient for anyone visiting or waiting for someone at Nakhonping Hospital. It is just a short walk from the side exit of the hospital, making it a perfect spot to relax while waiting for your appointment or visiting relatives.

Free Wi-Fi is available for customers, so you can work, read, or simply enjoy your time with a cup of coffee by the water.

Overall, Baan Yam Chaidan Coffee offers a peaceful retreat with good drinks, kind service, and a refreshing natural setting. It is a wonderful spot for anyone looking to take a break and enjoy a slow moment in the middle of the day.

Dr. Niwech

user_reviews.Description: Not a good experience. Ordered hot lemon tea. It was so sweet it was undrinkable. Re-ordered hot water and lemon. It too was undrinkable as the large lady added salt (to her) taste and the lemon is syrup not fresh lemon. With two simple meals the bill totalled 330bht. I ordered plain rice with omelet on menu for 70bht but was charged 90bht. When questioned the large lady again said it was with pork?? But I only ordered rice omelet on menu for 70bht. So, they charged 120 bht for two drinks that we couldn’t drink plus an extra 20 bht for pork in an omelet that isn’t even on the menu. Seems the large lady decides what you are ordering and then overcharges you. I always thought it is the customer who decides how they like their food and drinks. DO NOT waste your time entering the door. The temple is great but Coffee Nine is an incompetent and expensive experience. Go elsewhere!!!!!!!

user_reviews.text_translated: The cafe is located in Ban Mae Khi, Mae Ram Subdistrict, Mae Rim District. Customers set their GPS to my orange orchard and then purchased a coupon specifying that they wanted to go to the cafe as the starting point. The cafe will send a car to pick you up because the road to the cafe is quite difficult. Upon arrival, the cafe is like a small wooden house. The selling point is that you can climb up to the roof to take pictures. The cafe also has a flower garden with various photo opportunities. As for the drinks, I tried the strawberry milk, which is the cafe's signature menu item, but for me, it was just okay. I don't know about others' opinions. Another menu item, the green tea, was decent. The prices are a bit high, even with the coupon, at 70 baht per glass. But if you consider that you're coming for the photo-taking experience, it balances out. The staff seemed a bit grumpy today.

เมนูอร่อย – ทั้งพ่อและลูกก็ฟิน วันนี้คุณพ่อได้ลอง คาปูชิโน่เย็น รสชาติกลมกล่อมลงตัว เข้มข้น สดชื่น ถูกใจคอกาแฟอย่างคุณพ่อมากๆ ครับ! ส่วนเมนูของเจ้าตัวเล็ก ได้ลอง ขนมปังปิ้งเนยนม และ วาฟเฟิลโปะวิปครีมฝอยทอง บอกเลยว่าอร่อยจนลูกแย่งกันกินไม่หยุด หวานกำลังดีไม่เลี่ยน กรอบนอกนุ่มใน เนื้อในนุ่มละมุนเหมาะกับเด็กๆ เป็นที่สุด เห็นลูกๆ กินอย่างเอร็ดอร่อย คุณพ่อก็ปลื้มปริ่มแล้วครับ!

user_reviews.text_translated:
Longcha Coffee – A Family's Favorite Spot

Today, Dad wants to share a coffee shop near our house that we recently visited with our two little ones. We both loved it!

Atmosphere – Warm and homey. The shop is simply decorated in warm white tones, creating a friendly, airy, and comfortable atmosphere. There are cute little corners, like a big teddy bear to cuddle. Importantly, there's a garden area on the side and a front patio for the kids to play freely, making them happy and giving Dad a relaxing time. It's perfect for enjoying a relaxing coffee, reading a book, or playing with the kids.

Delicious Menu – Both Dad and the kids loved it! Today, Dad tried the Iced Cappuccino; it was perfectly balanced, rich, refreshing, and a favorite of a coffee lover like me! The little ones tried the buttered toast and the waffle with whipped cream and shredded egg yolk topping. They were so delicious they couldn't stop eating! It was just the right amount of sweetness, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside – perfect for kids. Seeing them enjoy it so much made Dad happy!

Service – Warm and welcoming, like visiting a friend's house. The staff at the shop are very welcoming and attentive to the children, providing friendly service. It felt like visiting a friend's house.

Overall impression – This shop is perfect for families.
Overall, Longcha Coffee is a very family-friendly cafe. It's ideal for parents looking for a coffee shop with a nice atmosphere where their children can relax, with comfortable seating, and enjoy coffee while they watch their kids. (They also have a food menu, but I'll do a full review of that next time.)

ON THE WAY CAFE
On The Way Cafe
📍Located on the new San Kamphaeng road, just past the Bo Sang intersection.
📍Plenty of parking inside, and the shop opens very early at 7 am, perfect for travelers or locals to stop by before work.
📍Very affordable prices starting at 35 baht. Considering the taste, it's great value. Today I tried the iced macchiato; the coffee and milk flavors were perfectly separated and delicious.
📍The service was lovely; the staff were friendly and chatty.
📍The shop is nicely decorated; small but comfortable.
📍They also have free crispy snacks that I loved as a kid available for you to help yourself to.
👉 If you're passing through this area, stop by and try it. It's incredibly worth it – truly lives up to the shop's motto: "Delicious down to the last drop."

user_reviews.Description:
Last Sunday I went to OMG and had their famous Sunday Roast.  I usually find a meal of this size too much and that is why I haven't had one previously.  Well - it was delicious, and beautifully cooked and served - a truly outstanding meal.  I was well stuffed!

My second review:
Tonight I went along to OMG's third anniversary party.  And, OMG (pun intended) - is it really only three years that OMG has been in Chiang Mai.  It seems so much longer - they have established themselves as a superb restaurant and bar, with many loyal customers.

The food and drinks are excellent, the staff are friendly and efficient, and on top of that, the owners have organized many events to support local charities and orphanages.  Long may they remain a successful bar-restaurant here.

My original review:
OMG - a new pretender to claim the crown of "best fish & chips in Chiang Mai'.

This well positioned site on the eastern corner of Loi Kroh, just prior to the Iron Bridge, has proved a graveyard for previous restaurants, having seen about 3 fail there in the past few years.

I sincerely hope this new one survives; it should. It has been thoroughly modernized and is clean as a new pin. The hostesses are divine and the owners very friendly.

Lots of dining and bar space, the cleanest toilets I've seen in a long while, a pool table, big TV screen and comprehensive menu. One could ask for nothing more.

I would hope to try some of the other dishes, but with 'fish & chips' this good, I won't be having anything else for a while. "OMG" uses only Atlantic cod (as does Kelly's, the previous holder of 'best fish & chips', but that's out of town).

Very highly recommended.
user_reviews.text_original:
Last Sunday I went to OMG and had their famous Sunday Roast.  I usually find a meal of this size too much and that is why I haven't had one previously.  Well - it was delicious, and beautifully cooked and served - a truly outstanding meal.  I was well stuffed!

My second review:
Tonight I went along to OMG's third anniversary party.  And, OMG (pun intended) - is it really only three years that OMG has been in Chiang Mai.  It seems so much longer - they have established themselves as a superb restaurant and bar, with many loyal customers.

The food and drinks are excellent, the staff are friendly and efficient, and on top of that, the owners have organized many events to support local charities and orphanages.  Long may they remain a successful bar-restaurant here.

user_reviews.text_translated: We went to CHEETAH CAFÉ with friends last week. ☕ The cafe is decorated so cutely! It's a glass-walled room with adorable interior decorations, including a cute tiger doll 🐆 and small potted plants 🌻🍀✨💝. They have a variety of cakes and pastries 🍪🍰 and a wide selection of drinks at reasonable prices. Tea/coffee is 40-50 baht ☕, matcha is 50-60 baht 🍵, and soda is 35-40 baht 🍹. Add toppings or extra shots for 5-15 baht 🧋. We ordered an iced cappuccino, regular sweetness ☕. Our drinks arrived quickly after ordering. We enjoyed a relaxing time in the cool air conditioning, took some photos, and then left. 📸❤️🐆 For anyone looking for a relaxing cafe to chill in the afternoon or on a weekend, we highly recommend this place. user_reviews.Description:
รีวิวจากใจลูกค้าคนนึ่ง ที่อยากหาร้านนั่งดื่มกาแฟอร่อยๆ แอร์เย็นๆ เบอเกอรี่หวานๆ

ผ่านมาถนนเส้นนี้ มีหลายร้านให้เลือก แต่เราก็สะดุดตากับร้านทรงโมเดิลๆ (มองจากข้างนอก) จึงคิดว่าต้องมีกาแฟดีๆแน่เลย อีกทั้งที่จอดรถก็กว้างมาก

...พอเปิดประตูเข้าไปผมก็สั่งเมนู คาราเมลเมคคิเอโต้ พนักงานก็ถามเอาหวานไหม ผมให้บอกว่าเอาหวานปกติครับ จากนั้นก็ถามต่อว่าเมล็ดคั่วอะไร ผมก็บอกว่าปกติร้านใช้ตัวไหน ก็เลือกตัวนั้น พนักงานทำหน้าไม่พอใจ แล้วถามต่อว่า รับเมล็ดคั่วอะไรดีคะ มีกลาง กับเข้ม  ผมกห้ย้ำคำเดิมว่า เอาสูตรปกติของร้านเลยครับ (ผมอยากรู้ว่าปกติของร้านเสิร์ฟแบบไหน ก็แค่ต้องการแบบนั้น) จากนั้นพนักงานก็ถามอีกรอบ จนผมต้องบอกว่าเข้มก็ได้ครับ  พอมาผมขยับไปสั่งเบเกอรี่อีก 2 ชิ้น

...และที่สำคัญตอนทำเสร็จไม่บอก ไม่เรียกอะไรทั้งนั้น วางไว้ที่เคาเตอร์เฉยๆ ถ้าผมไม่หันไปมองก็คงไม่รู้ว่าได้แล้ว  จริงๆ เคาท์เตอร์กับโต๊ะที่ผมมันห่างกันแค่ 2 เมตร  ใกล้มาก ไม่ต้องเดินมาก็ได้ แค่เรียกสักหน่อยก็ยังดี ตอนสั่งราคาเมลเมคคิเอโต้เเก้วแรก ผมยังแอบคิดในใจน้องเค้าคงเรียกแล้วผมไม่ได้ยินมั้ง แต่รอบสองผมสั่งอเมริกาโน่ ก็ไม่เรียก เล็กๆ น้อยๆ ก็สะกิตหน่อยครับ อย่างน้อยๆ ลูกค้าจะได้ลุกมาเอาตอนน้ำเเข็งยังไม่ละลาย

รสชาติกาแฟ
- คาราเมลเมคคิเอโต้ ไม่ผ่านครับ มันไม่มีความหอมกรแฟ หรือ หอมคาราเมล มีแต่ความหวาน แล้วก็หวานจนเกินพอดี (เรื่องหวานมาก หววานน้อย ผมพอเข้าใจว่าแต่ละคนไม่เท่ากัน แต่นี้มันหวานเกินจนผมดื่มไม่ได้ ต้องสั่งอเมริกาโน่มาอีกแก้ว)
- อเมริกาโน่ ไม่ผ่านครับ สั่งคั่วกลาง สกัดออกมาได้เข้มบาดคอ กลิ่นไหม้มาเต็มๆ
- ส่วนขนมอีก 2 ชิ้นอร่อยมากครับ โดยเฉพาะ ขนมปังหน้าชีส+ข้าวโพด

user_reviews.text_translated:
A heartfelt review from a customer looking for a nice place to enjoy delicious coffee, cool air conditioning, and sweet pastries.

Passing by this street, there are many cafes to choose from, but I was drawn to this modern-looking shop (from the outside), thinking it must have good coffee. Plus, the parking lot was very spacious.

...Upon entering, I ordered a Caramel Macchiato. The staff asked if I wanted it sweet; I said normal sweetness. Then they asked what kind of beans they used. I told them what they usually use. The staff looked displeased and asked, "What roast would you like? Medium or dark." I reiterated, "The regular blend, please." (I just wanted to know what they usually serve it as.) The staff asked again until I finally said, "Dark, please." Then I ordered two more pastries.

...And importantly, when it was ready, they didn't tell me or call me at all. They just placed it on the counter. If I hadn't looked over, I wouldn't have known it was ready. Actually, the counter and my table were only about 2 meters apart – very close. They didn't need to walk over; just calling out would have been nice. When I ordered my first Caramel Macchiato, I secretly thought maybe the staff called out to me and I didn't hear them. But the second time I ordered an Americano, they didn't call out either. Even small gestures would be nice; at least a little nudge would get the customer to come get their order before the ice melts.

Coffee Taste:
- Caramel Macchiato: A failure. It lacked any coffee or caramel aroma; it was just excessively sweet. (I understand that everyone's preference is different, but this was so sweet I couldn't drink it. I had to order another Americano.)
- Americano: A failure. I ordered a medium roast, but the extraction was too strong and harsh, with a strong burnt smell.
- The other two pastries were delicious, especially the cheese and corn bread.

Summary:
Coffee taste: Fail.
Pastries: Delicious (some items).
Atmosphere: Average.
Limited seating (the second floor was closed the day I went).
Staff: Not very friendly.

user_reviews.Description:
In the fast-paced world of business, finding a space that fosters both productivity and inspiration can be a challenge. Wake Up Coffee, nestled amidst the urban landscape, emerges as a vibrant solution, offering a professional haven fueled by exquisite coffee and a meticulously curated ambiance.

Beyond the mid-range price point, which caters to both discerning palates and budget-conscious individuals, Wake Up Coffee distinguishes itself through its commitment to quality. Meticulously sourced beans, roasted to perfection, sing in every cup, whether you opt for a bold espresso or a creamy cappuccino. This dedication to artisanal brewing ensures a consistently satisfying coffee experience, never compromising on flavor or aroma.

The spacious interior, bathed in natural light, provides ample room for focused work or collaborative brainstorming. Minimalist elegance blends with warm wooden accents, creating a serene yet invigorating atmosphere. Pops of color inject a touch of playful energy, while the overall design prioritizes functionality, with ample table space and conveniently placed power outlets. This thoughtfully crafted environment fosters a sense of belonging, making it ideal for meetings, solo work sessions, or simply enjoying a break in a comfortable and aesthetically pleasing setting.

What truly sets Wake Up Coffee apart is its 24-hour operation. It becomes a beacon for the nocturnal workforce, a sanctuary for entrepreneurs and remote professionals burning the midnight oil. The seamless Wi-Fi and strategically placed power outlets transform the space into a vibrant co-working hub, where the gentle hum of conversation and the occasional clinking of cups provide a comforting backdrop for focused work. This 24/7 accessibility makes Wake Up Coffee a haven for those who thrive under the cloak of night, offering a space where deadlines and creative pursuits can flourish regardless of the hour.

Whether you're a seasoned professional seeking a stimulating environment to kick-start your day or a freelancer chasing the perfect work haven, Wake Up Coffee delivers on all fronts. It's a place where exquisite coffee meets inspiring ambiance, where productivity flourishes alongside community, and where every cup is an invitation to awaken your full potential. It's not just about the caffeine; it's about creating a space for professional growth, fostering collaboration, and offering a serene oasis to recharge and thrive, 24 hours a day.

I give Doi Pui Coffee 4 stars. Reason is that the Americano Orange is of really good quality, made with fresh oranges! Really nice.

The service of this place is okay. The only thing what I don't get it why, when the shop is empty, they don't serve the coffee; you need to pick it up.

The atmosphere is, actually, not okay. It's old and really needs to be cleaned and refreshed. The furniture is old and broke.

I really think when the owner invests a bit in renovation, there will be more customers.

The location is perfect , just opposed the bus stations 2 and 3.

user_reviews.Description:
The signs inside clearly state that charging costs 20 Baht for 1 hour. But we were then informed that charging for 15 minutes (as that's all the time we had to drink our coffee before getting the bus) would cost 20 Baht. That equates to 80 Baht per hour....the signs are very misleading, and do not mention any minimum charge.

No toilet is available for customers. There is a bathroom there, but the guy said that it is only for him and customers cannot use it.
